title: Only the author edits/attaches; delete needs authorship or record Delete
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user, on the build under test. The Notifications Center feature is on.
  2. A note authored by someone else on a work order; sign in as the author, as a non-author holding "Work Orders -> Delete", and as a non-author without it.
custom_steps:
1. As the author, edit the note and add/remove an attachment.
  2. As a non-author without Delete, look for edit and delete on the note.
  3. As a non-author holding "Work Orders -> Delete", look for delete on a work order / line / part sale note (and "Customers -> Delete" for a customer or asset note).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only the note's author can edit a note or add and remove its attachments; a non-author is not offered edit.
  • A note can be deleted by its author, or by a user who holds Delete for the kind of record it is on - "Work Orders -> Delete" for a work order, work order line or part sale note, and "Customers -> Delete" for a customer or asset note; a non-author without that Delete is not offered delete.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Permissions); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S10; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R5: “Only the note's author can edit a note or add and remove its attachments.”
  • S10-R5a: “A note can be deleted by its author, or by a user who holds Delete for the kind of record it is on: 'Work Orders -> Delete' for a work order, work order line or part sale note, and 'Customers -> Delete' for a customer or asset note.”
  • S10-N1: “A user who is not a note's author is not offered edit on it (S10-R5). A user who is not the author and does not hold Delete for that kind of record is not offered delete (S10-R5a).”
